def factor_volume_return_directional_corr_robust_vol(df):
    """Rolling correlation between daily return and robust volume deviation."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    daily_ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    vol_median = df_copy["volume"].rolling(20, min_periods=5).median()
    vol_mad = (df_copy["volume"] - vol_median).abs().rolling(20, min_periods=5).median()
    vol_dev = (df_copy["volume"] - vol_median) / vol_mad.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    corr = daily_ret.rolling(30, min_periods=20).corr(vol_dev)
    factor = corr.fillna(0.0)
    df_copy["factor_volume_return_directional_corr_robust_vol"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_volume_return_directional_corr_robust_vol"]
